A late eligible priority unit correctly receives the next request. The one-pass endpoint proves an exhausted opponent case with a pass. An unequal Remaining inventory with an exhausted actor skipped without a prior pass was not explicitly exercised.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: No model part may finish penetrating an enclosed Solid feature at or below three inches, including openings.
native_evidence.scope: The endpoint owner rejects a prohibited protruding body part and enclosed Solid opening in the low fixture; a clear shifted body, higher endpoint, and Light comparison distinguish the collision rule. The exact three-inch equality case is absent from these fixtures.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: A unit controls a player-controlled objective only when one of its in-range models has positive OC.
native_evidence.scope: The archived requirement says the same positive-OC model must be in range. The unchanged adopted text predicates range on the unit and positive OC on a member, consistent with Order 109. The native-body checkpoint proves an in-range OC0 body and an out-of-range OC-positive attached member can control a friendly-controlled objective. The companion overlap control confirms the same in-range model supplies its complete OC to both results. The absence of such a member or missing range rejects unit control. Historical wording remains preserved and requires evidence-inventory reconciliation.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: At battle start objectives are uncontrolled until positive OC models establish control; terrain range means within the area.
native_evidence.scope: The constructed precontrol state has no initial record, and actual control begins with positive native in-range contributors, including upper terrain membership. Full battle-start traversal is unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Use Epic Challenge just after a friendly unit is selected to fight.
native_evidence.scope: Prepared selected-Fight context and wrong-phase denial. No ordinary Fight activation producer asserted by these cases.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Crushing Impact costs one CP.
native_evidence.scope: Accepted native use confirms the target ledger but the case does not assert CP debit.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Use Crushing Impact immediately after a friendly Charge move in the own Charge phase.
native_evidence.scope: Current owner verifies prepared own Charge/charged unit window. Physical movement producing the window is outside these controls.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: The target unit must be eligible to shoot.
native_evidence.scope: Advance and phase gates checked. No independent shooting-ineligible reason where all other Explosives premises remain legal.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Choose an unengaged enemy visible to and within eight inches of that model.
native_evidence.scope: Engaged/too-far negative and selected victim receive real damage. Visibility-only denial and exact eight-inch boundary remain open.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Starting an action prevents charge declaration through turn end.
native_evidence.scope: The live Charge eligibility reason persists through all mapped terminal Action statuses including the Titanic shooting exception. The same actor's actual next-turn Charge offer is unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Destroying an empty Dedicated Transport at formation completion does not trigger model-destruction rules.
native_evidence.scope: The flag and complete log confirm no individual destruction reaction is emitted for the empty carrier, and repeated cleanup stays inert. The fixture does not first show that an admitted configured model-death reaction would trigger for this same carrier in an ordinary destruction.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: After the first battle round starts, a completed Normal, Advance or Fall Back move can offer an embark decision.
native_evidence.scope: Normal Movement offers and commits an actual Embark. Advance/Fall Back reach the same typed owner with supplied completed histories. Their ordinary facade offer continuations are unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Each embarked unit must emergency disembark before its destroyed transport is removed.
native_evidence.scope: The typed closest legal Emergency placement is applied with the destroyed carrier still physically present. The single-passenger fixture does not require sequential completion of every embarked unit on a shared carrier.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Combat disembark leaves the passenger Battle-shocked.
native_evidence.scope: Accepted Combat resolution returns until-cleared Battle-shock and a charge prohibition in the typed outcome. The selected Combat controls do not submit placement through completion and assert the actual shared Battle-shock state or downstream permission after injury resolution.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Combat disembark prevents declaring a charge until turn end.
native_evidence.scope: Accepted typed Combat places the passenger, rolls hazards and records no Charge plus a Battle-shock directive. The public live mutation and prohibition/expiry are unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Combat disembark places each model wholly within six inches of the transport.
native_evidence.scope: A ground endpoint from a carrier on an explicit elevated platform uses the Combat placement path when Tactical feasibility fails; the endpoint checks independently gate engagement. The focused suite does not isolate an exact six-inch acceptance/rejection boundary for Combat.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Rapid disembark prevents declaring a charge until turn end.
native_evidence.scope: A committed Rapid row records the charge prohibition. The selected live case does not carry that same accepted passenger through expiry or the separate out-of-turn FAQ 71 route.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Tactical disembark immediately selects a Normal or Advance follow-up move.
native_evidence.scope: Accepted Tactical Disembark keeps movement available and excludes choosing Stationary at the state boundary. The immediate native Normal/Advance menu and command are unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Emergency disembark prevents declaring a charge until turn end.
native_evidence.scope: Emergency outcome records the turn owner and charge prohibition. Explicit active-turn cleanup removes the disembark restriction while Battle-shock stays. The Emergency controls do not query a legal downstream Charge offer during the live restriction and at expiry.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Only when unengaged setup is impossible may a passenger be set up engaged, still as close as possible within the setup band.
native_evidence.scope: An available unengaged side prevents the engaged placement. A ring of actual enemy bodies makes the close engaged fixture legal. The numeric not-closest check is on the unengaged path; a strictly farther otherwise legal engaged fallback after the same impossibility proof is unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Emergency placement uses the shared setup authority.
native_evidence.scope: Actual Emergency public setup applies physical placements, with distance rejection and exact retry, restore, fork and replay. Independent rejection of a general §03.02 constraint, such as an incoherent otherwise-legal survivor endpoint, is not asserted on the same Emergency path.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: The unit must be embarked in a transport on the battlefield.
native_evidence.scope: The Assault positive is a present loaded carrier. Shared owner negatives use the ordinary mode rather than a source-granted Assault request.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Every disembark move type counts as having disembarked that turn.
native_evidence.scope: Tactical, Rapid, Assault and Shock public placements all commit one typed disembark movement history. Converted Assault/Shock movement executions restore and replay those histories exactly. Native Emergency emits unit_disembarked. Combat was exercised at the typed resolver without a public shared-history assertion; the every-mode claim stays partial.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Aerialists can embark after disembarking this turn because its embarkation does not include a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move.
native_evidence.scope: A supplied source-owned no-move occasion allows re-Embark after Disembark while preserving another type gate. Ordinary same-turn setup controls remain forbidden. No admitted actual Aerialists datasheet provider was exercised.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: A Bodyguard-sourced unit ability ends when its last Bodyguard model is destroyed, subject to attack-sequence retention.
native_evidence.scope: The compiled Bodyguard grant reaches every living component when one source model remains, then drops at the final source casualty. This is the reserve/checkpoint source-lifetime route. Taking the last bodyguard casualty from an attack and expiry only after the attacker finishes all attacks were not exercised.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: A Leader or Support unit ability ends when that component’s last model is destroyed, subject to attack-sequence retention.
native_evidence.scope: A native leading weapon grant survives bodyguard loss but drops when its leader dies. Independent compiled leader and support grants end at the respective final source casualty. The target-restriction control proves retained support presence under a different source and route. The same leader/support weapon grant through last-source attack death and through the end of all attacks is unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: A specific bearer’s attached-unit ability ends when that bearer is destroyed, subject to attack-sequence retention.
native_evidence.scope: A constructed unit-wide weapon grant bound to actual equipped native wargear survives an unrelated casualty and disappears when its bearer is killed by the normal rule-caused model-destruction owner. The reserve checkpoint also binds grant recovery to the same revived model. The test does not exercise an attacking-unit attack sequence.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Declare Battle Formations offers friendly units an optional Strategic Reserves declaration instead of battlefield deployment.
native_evidence.scope: At the declared prebattle setup step the real options owner offers only eligible units and the typed declaration stores the selected rows. The public optional completion followed by nonselected deployment is unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Final reserve cleanup does not trigger model-destruction rules.
native_evidence.scope: Final reserve death leaves the pending return queue empty. The carrier-and-cargo variant additionally asserts the complete decision event log is identical across application. No case first demonstrates that a seeded, admitted model-destruction rule would otherwise trigger for the same body, and no final-turn facade handoff is supplied.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: The fifty-percent Strategic Reserves cap applies only before the battle; battle-time reserve entry can exceed it.
native_evidence.scope: The pregame and round-two controls establish opposite sides of the limit. There is no separately exercised battle-time reposition immediately after first-round start.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: A Flying unit may declare take to the skies before Normal, Advance, Fall Back or Charge movement.
native_evidence.scope: Public Charge and Advance offer/record the declared flight choice before their dice, and the supported Normal-flight command restores and replays. The selected active cases do not directly exercise pre-path flight selection specifically for Fall Back.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: A unit-owned wargear item grants its ability to that unit.
native_evidence.scope: Native item grant and independent typed whole-unit recipient rules verified. The native equipped item is not itself exercised as a whole-unit granted effect here.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Plunging Fire requires a visible target unit containing a ground-level model.
native_evidence.scope: Legal visible targets at proper range gain the constructed Towering branch when a target stands on ground; elevated targets or out-of-range cases do not. The sibling-height owner verifies physical source scope. A hidden but otherwise qualifying ground target is not independently contrasted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Core abilities belong to datasheets and weapon abilities to weapon profiles; bracketed weapon-ability notation is normalized at the source boundary.
native_evidence.scope: Actual Core datasheet abilities reach the unit-level gates and actual weapon profiles retain typed keyword targeting and roundtrip independently. This pair does not assert raw bracketed source admission and rejection across the distinct families.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Each Select Weapons step selects one instance of duplicated weapon ability families, including different numbers or keywords.
native_evidence.scope: One selected Sustained Hits source reaches output and does not stack. Keyword-duplicate selection and the ordinary Select Weapons request are unasserted here.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Cleave X adds X dice per complete five target models only if the weapon allocated every attack to one target.
native_evidence.scope: Actual helper applies count bonus when given whole-weapon single-target condition. Multi-attack declaration must still prove it sets the whole-weapon single-target condition.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: On a trigger, each unit within six inches suffers X mortal wounds, rolling random X separately per unit.
native_evidence.scope: Native source has the correct trigger, six-inch range, and random damage expression, and retained casualty cleanup runs the reaction after physical removal. Neither binds independent random rolls and actual allocations for multiple qualifying units.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: A destroyed model with Deadly Demise rolls a D6 and triggers on six.
native_evidence.scope: The native source records six as trigger and cleanup invokes reaction. No corresponding actual five-versus-six outcome on a destroyed native carrier in these bindings.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Deep Strike ingress requires the ability on every model in the unit.
native_evidence.scope: Native Hawks and Bloodcrushers expose Deep Strike and the ordinary declaration records it. Non-Deep-Strike Infractors fail the ability query and the opponent Lord lacks the declaration option. There is no live mixed-model or mixed-component ingress assertion in this pass.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Deep Strike may set up anywhere, including the enemy zone, while remaining more than eight horizontal inches from enemies.
native_evidence.scope: The live public Bloodcrushers path rejects a too-close arrival, reopens selection, and commits all models on a legal retry. The policy asserts eight inches with no edge or enemy-zone restriction. The public fixture does not isolate exact equality or put the accepted physical placement in the enemy deployment zone.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Infiltrator deployment requires the ability on every model.
native_evidence.scope: Native Rangers have Infiltrators and can redeploy forward where native Avengers cannot. Prior evidence also accepts in-zone Avengers and rejects Rangers close to the opponent zone. No active mixed-component negative verifies the all-model requirement.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Infiltrators may deploy outside their own zone but must be more than eight horizontal inches from the opponent’s zone.
native_evidence.scope: Native Infiltrator and redeploy placement positives and invalidity. Exact enemy-zone number depends on tested coordinates and is not credited here.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: A nonattached Lone Operative is invisible to enemies farther than twelve inches.
native_evidence.scope: Direct threshold at explicitly supplied 12 checked. Bare keyword default and other visibility consumers not independently exercised in this control.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Indirect Fire cannot target a nonattached Lone Operative beyond twelve inches.
native_evidence.scope: Indirect threshold at explicitly supplied 12 checked. Bare source default remains unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Pistol and Close-quarters are the same ability for all rules purposes.
native_evidence.scope: Sidearm and Close-quarters consumers are verified under their controls. Whole-runtime alias equivalence needs an identical two-label comparison.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: During Muster Armies a Leader or Support may select one eligible friendly Bodyguard to form an attached unit for the battle.
native_evidence.scope: Formation owner attaches explicitly supplemented Support. No ordinary native Support-provider roster is evidenced.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Players show their completed roster to the opponent before battle.
native_evidence.scope: Both player roles see the opponent roster and physical bearer publicly during setup. The formation and transport manifest fields are deliberately hidden until resolution, which the mapped cases do not traverse to observe prebattle reveal.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: The selected battle size determines points, Detachment Points, Enhancement and datasheet-copy limits.
native_evidence.scope: Incursion and Strike Force use different point, Enhancement and copy limits, plus an explicit Incursion DP control. Paired selection authority and the exact Strike Force DP boundary are outside this union.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Strike Force permits 2000 points, three Detachment Points, four Enhancements and three ordinary copies per datasheet.
native_evidence.scope: Strike Force has exact 2000-point, four-Enhancement and three-ordinary-copy positive and over-limit controls. There is no active assertion here for accepting 3 DP and rejecting 4 DP.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Select a Character unit of the army faction and one Character model in it as Warlord.
native_evidence.scope: The chosen eligible Character model alone gets WARLORD and the record survives serialization. A nonexistent model index rejects. The live controls reviewed here do not isolate valid-index non-Character and off-faction negatives.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Selecting a detachment grants its recorded rules, dispositions, Enhancements and Stratagem inventory.
native_evidence.scope: The selected detachment exposes its dispositions, Enhancements and Stratagem IDs and rejects an unavailable Enhancement. Detachment-rule inventory or downstream rule execution is unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Roster units must carry the army faction keyword or be explicitly available to that army faction.
native_evidence.scope: Real units reach physical composition/equipment with matching faction and a foreign unit without permission is rejected. An explicit out-of-faction availability grant is unasserted.

native_evidence.order135_obligation: Roster totals must obey all limits for the selected battle size.
native_evidence.scope: Each budget group has meaningful independent executable controls. The mapped selected sizes still lack an exact Strike Force detachment-point rejection boundary.

Paid native grant commits Normal despite eligible Overrun. Own fix lane #756.
Native weapon attack count supplies no Command Re-roll offer before the first Hit roll. Separate fix lane.
